svg.text: (a) Local Zoom-Out Across 2×2 Cells (No Global Decoder)
Cold Bath (Below Tc): Small Pairs Cancel Inside 2×2 Cells
Warm Bath (Above Tc): Error Chains Cross Cell Walls & Multiply
(b) Live Defect Zoom-Out Inside One 322k-Qubit Bath
Zoom-Out Step: Fine Lattice (322k) → Coarse Cell (19q)
(c) Five Code Sizes Share the Same Threshold
